headline: Strongpoint Battles Resume on Weathered Expanse and DeadLands
war_summary: Since the last edition, the Weathered Expanse has returned to the head of the list: fifty-nine strategic-base events in the past day and eight in the latest two hours, with Wightwalk and Frostmarch the busiest named points. DeadLands and Stonecradle each logged three events in the same window, while Stlican Shelf, Linn Mercy, and Godcrofts each added two. Those six hexes account for twenty events in the latest two-hour tally. Linn Mercy, quiet in the previous bulletin, has resumed base changes; Stlican Shelf continues to show heavy activity around Breaker Town and The Pale House. Stonecradle and the DeadLands both report heavy one-hour casualty counts as well. Callahan's Passage, which earlier traded strongpoints at The Latch, has had no fresh strategic-base event since mid-afternoon. Elsewhere, many hexes remain one-faction holdings with only enlistment and light losses. The Weathered Expanse leads the casualty wires, with Colonial losses above eleven hundred an hour and Warden losses near one thousand an hour. Neither army has yet secured the thirty-four victory towns needed for decision.
